# GlowScroll: LED Banner & Sign

> GlowScroll turns a phone or tablet into a bright scrolling LED sign for concerts, airport pickups, games and events. It is made by THE LIX GROUP LLC for Android (on Google Play) and iOS (coming soon). There is no account, no ads and no tracking in the app; signs are stored on the user's device, with optional backup to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive. It is free to use; a one-time Premium purchase (no subscription) unlocks extra looks and fonts, unlimited saved signs, folders and automatic backup.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Android, on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lixlink.glowscroll. iOS (iPhone and iPad) coming soon.
- Category: Utilities (LED banner, scrolling text sign)
- Account required: No
- Data storage: On the user's device. No GlowScroll server.
- Backup: Export/import a file (free); automatic backup to the user's own iCloud or Google Drive app folder (Premium).
- Free: scrolling LED and smooth text, colors, speed and direction, blink and rainbow effects, mirror mode, Flash Safety, quick phrases, 22 templates, 4 fonts, 20 saved signs, export/import, any language and emoji
- Premium (one-time, no subscription): Square LED, Pixel and Neon looks, 8 more fonts, unlimited saved signs, folders, automatic cloud backup, future Premium features
- Support: glowscroll-support@lixlink.com
